objectives.en: I can use at with clock times, on with days and dates, and in with months, years, seasons and parts of the day.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להשתמש ב-at עם שעות, ב-on עם ימים ותאריכים, וב-in עם חודשים, שנים, עונות וחלקי היום.

objectives.en: I can say when things happen in my week.
objectives.he: אני יכול/ה לספר מתי דברים קורים בשבוע שלי.

objectives.en: I know when not to use a preposition: every day, next week, last Friday.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת מתי לא משתמשים במילת יחס: every day, next week, last Friday.

warmup.en: When is your birthday? What time do you get up? Which days do you work or study? Answer in English, and look at the small word before each time.
warmup.he: מתי יום ההולדת שלכם? באיזו שעה אתם קמים? באילו ימים אתם עובדים או לומדים? ענו באנגלית, ושימו לב למילה הקטנה שלפני כל זמן.

explanation.en: Lior's guitar lesson is on Tuesday at 5:30. In the summer, it's in the morning, and his concert is on 12 August. Each kind of time has its own small word: at, on or in.
explanation.he: שיעור הגיטרה של ליאור ביום שלישי ב-5:30. בקיץ השיעור בבוקר, וההופעה שלו ב-12 באוגוסט. באנגלית לכל סוג של זמן יש מילה קטנה משלו: at, on או in.

rows: clock times: at 7:00, at half past six
at night, at midnight, at lunchtime
a day + part of it: on Friday evening
parts of the day: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening

explanation.en: at = an exact time (a point). on = a day or a date. in = a longer time: a month, a year, a season, or a part of the day.
explanation.he: at = זמן מדויק (נקודה בזמן). ‏on = יום או תאריך. ‏in = פרק זמן ארוך יותר: חודש, שנה, עונה, או חלק מהיום.

explanation.en: Watch these: in the morning, but at night. in the evening, but on Friday evening (a day + part of the day → on). No preposition before every, next, last, this, today or tomorrow: I see her every Monday (not 'on every Monday').
explanation.he: שימו לב: in the morning, אבל at night. ‏in the evening, אבל on Friday evening (יום + חלק מהיום → on). לפני every, next, last, this, today ו-tomorrow לא שמים מילת יחס: I see her every Monday (ולא on every Monday).

explanation.en: The weekend: British English says at the weekend; American English says on the weekend. Both are correct, so choose one. Never in the weekend.
explanation.he: סוף השבוע: באנגלית בריטית אומרים at the weekend, ובאנגלית אמריקאית on the weekend. שתי הצורות נכונות – בחרו אחת. אבל אף פעם לא in the weekend.

examples.en: I have English on Sundays and Wednesdays.
examples.he: יש לי אנגלית בימי ראשון ורביעי.

examples.note: say: on the third of June

examples.en: We go to the beach a lot in the summer.
She studies in the evening and works at night.

examples.note: day + part of the day → on

examples.en: I go to the gym every Tuesday.
examples.he: אני הולך/ת לחדר כושר כל יום שלישי.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: Hebrew writing works differently: it has no capital letters, so they are easy to forget. In English, days and months always start with a capital letter: on Monday, in May. Seasons don't: in summer, in winter.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית אין אותיות גדולות, ולכן קל לשכוח אותן. באנגלית ימים וחודשים תמיד מתחילים באות גדולה: on Monday, in May. עונות השנה – לא: in summer, in winter.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew the sound /w/ is rare, and the letter vav is usually /v/. So Wednesday, week and winter can sound like 'Vednesday', 'veek' and 'vinter'. For /w/, make your lips small and round, as for 'oo', and keep your teeth away from your lip.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית הצליל /w/ נדיר, והאות ו' נהגית בדרך כלל /v/. לכן Wednesday, week ו-winter יוצאות לפעמים עם v. ל-/w/ מעגלים את השפתיים כמו ב'אוּ', בלי שהשיניים יגעו בשפה.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: Hebrew has no /θ/ sound, so Thursday, third and month can come out with t or s. Put the tip of your tongue between your teeth and blow gently: /ˈθɜːzdeɪ/.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית אין את הצליל /θ/, ולכן Thursday, third ו-month יוצאות לפעמים עם ט' או ס'. שימו את קצה הלשון בין השיניים ונשפו בעדינות: Thursday.

prompt.en: at, on or in? Sort the time words.
prompt.he: at, ‏on או in? מיינו את מילות הזמן.

hint.en: An exact time, a day, or a longer time?
hint.he: זמן מדויק, יום, או פרק זמן ארוך?

explanation.en: at = exact times (7:30, midnight, lunchtime). on = days and dates (Monday, my birthday, 5 May). in = months, years, seasons and parts of the day (July, 2027, winter, the morning).
explanation.he: at = זמן מדויק (7:30, חצות, צהריים). ‏on = ימים ותאריכים (Monday, יום ההולדת, 5 May). ‏in = חודשים, שנים, עונות וחלקי היום (July, 2027, winter, the morning).

prompt.en: Match the time words with their Hebrew meaning.
prompt.he: התאימו כל מילת זמן באנגלית למשמעות שלה בעברית.

explanation.en: autumn is British English; Americans usually say fall. midnight is 12 o'clock at night: at midnight.
explanation.he: autumn היא המילה הבריטית; באמריקה אומרים בדרך כלל fall. ‏midnight היא 12 בלילה: at midnight.

exercises.audio_text: The concert is on Friday at half past eight.
exercises.question: When is the concert?

1.en: Listen for the day: Friday (with f), not Thursday (with th).
1.he: הקשיבו ליום: Friday (עם f), ולא Thursday (עם th).

2.en: half past eight = 8:30. (9:30 is half past nine.)
2.he: half past eight = 8:30. ‏(9:30 זה half past nine.)

explanation.en: on Friday (a day) + at half past eight (a clock time) = Friday at 8:30.
explanation.he: on Friday (יום) + at half past eight (שעה) = יום שישי ב-8:30.

prompt.en: Complete with in, on or at.

answers: at
on

feedback.en: We say in the evening, but with a day it's on: on Saturday evening. A clock time takes at: at 8:30.
feedback.he: אומרים in the evening, אבל כשיש יום אומרים on: on Saturday evening. עם שעה – at: at 8:30.

feedback.en: on is for days (on Saturday evening). A clock time takes at: at 8:30.
feedback.he: on הוא לימים (on Saturday evening). עם שעה אומרים at: at 8:30.

feedback.en: at is for clock times (at 8:30). A day + evening takes on: on Saturday evening.
feedback.he: at הוא לשעות (at 8:30). יום + ערב → on: on Saturday evening.

explanation.en: at + clock time (at 8:30). on + day, even with evening (on Saturday evening).
explanation.he: at + שעה (at 8:30). ‏on + יום, גם כשמוסיפים evening (on Saturday evening).

prompt.en: Complete with in, on or at.

exercises.text: My birthday is ___ August, so I never have school ___ my birthday!
answers: in
on

feedback.en: Months take in: in August. on is for days and special days: on my birthday.
feedback.he: עם חודשים אומרים in: in August. ‏on הוא לימים ולימים מיוחדים: on my birthday.

feedback.en: in is for months (in August). A special day takes on: on my birthday.
feedback.he: in הוא לחודשים (in August). יום מיוחד – on: on my birthday.

feedback.en: at is for clock times. Say in August and on my birthday.
feedback.he: at הוא לשעות. אומרים in August ו-on my birthday.

explanation.en: in August (a month) · on my birthday (a special day).
explanation.he: in August (חודש) · on my birthday (יום מיוחד).

0.en: This one is correct: it's British English.
0.he: המשפט הזה נכון – זו אנגלית בריטית.

1.en: This one is correct: it's American English.
1.he: המשפט הזה נכון – זו אנגלית אמריקאית.

explanation.en: at the weekend (UK) and on the weekend (US) are both correct. in the weekend is wrong.
explanation.he: at the weekend (בריטית) ו-on the weekend (אמריקאית) נכונים שניהם. ‏in the weekend – שגוי.

0.en: We say on Friday, but every replaces the preposition: every Friday.
0.he: אומרים on Friday, אבל every מחליף את מילת היחס: every Friday.

1.en: No preposition before every: I go swimming every Friday.
1.he: לפני every לא שמים מילת יחס: I go swimming every Friday.

2.en: No preposition before every: I go swimming every Friday.
2.he: לפני every לא שמים מילת יחס: I go swimming every Friday.

explanation.en: every, next, last and this come with no preposition: every Friday, next Friday.
explanation.he: every, next, last ו-this באים בלי מילת יחס: every Friday, next Friday.

exercises.question: Omer is a nurse. He often works when it's dark.

0.en: We say in the morning and in the evening, but at night.
0.he: אומרים in the morning ו-in the evening, אבל at night.

2.en: on is for days. For the time when it's dark, say at night.
2.he: on הוא לימים. לזמן שבו חושך אומרים at night.

explanation.en: at night is a fixed phrase, with no the: He often works at night.
explanation.he: at night הוא צירוף קבוע, בלי the: He often works at night.

prompt.en: This sentence has a mistake. Write it correctly.

We have a test Thursday morning.

hint.he: יום + חלק מהיום → המילה של הימים.

wrong_feedback.match: We have a test at Thursday morning.

feedback.en: at is for clock times. Thursday morning is a day, so use on.
feedback.he: at הוא לשעות. Thursday morning הוא יום, ולכן on.

explanation.en: in the morning, but on Thursday morning: when there's a day, use on.
explanation.he: in the morning, אבל on Thursday morning: כשיש יום, משתמשים ב-on.

exercises.sentence: I see my grandparents on every Saturday.
answers: I see my grandparents every Saturday.
I see my grandparents on Saturdays.

explanation.en: No preposition before every: every Saturday. (on Saturdays also means every Saturday.)
explanation.he: לפני every לא שמים מילת יחס: every Saturday. ‏(on Saturdays אומר אותו דבר.)

prompt.en: Rewrite the sentence with next instead of on.

feedback.en: next replaces on. No preposition before next: I'm busy next Sunday.
feedback.he: next מחליף את on. לפני next לא שמים מילת יחס: I'm busy next Sunday.

feedback.en: No preposition before next: I'm busy next Sunday.
feedback.he: לפני next לא שמים מילת יחס: I'm busy next Sunday.

explanation.en: next, last, every and this replace the preposition: next Sunday, last Sunday, every Sunday, this Sunday.
explanation.he: next, last, every ו-this מחליפים את מילת היחס: next Sunday, last Sunday, every Sunday, this Sunday.

prompt.en: Translate into English. Start with I have.

exercises.source: יש לי מבחן ביום ראשון בבוקר.

I have a test on Sunday in the morning.
I have a test Sunday morning.
I have an exam on Sunday morning.
I have an exam on Sunday in the morning.

I have got a test on Sunday in the morning.

hint.en: Use test. The time is one unit: a day + part of the day.
hint.he: מבחן = test. 'ביום ראשון בבוקר' הוא זמן אחד: יום + חלק מהיום.

wrong_feedback.match: I have a test in Sunday morning.

feedback.en: With a day, use on, even with morning: on Sunday morning.
feedback.he: כשיש יום משתמשים ב-on, גם עם morning: on Sunday morning.

wrong_feedback.match: I have a test at Sunday morning.

feedback.en: at is for clock times. A day + morning takes on: on Sunday morning.
feedback.he: at הוא לשעות. יום + בוקר → on: on Sunday morning.

wrong_feedback.match: I have test on Sunday morning.

feedback.en: In Hebrew there is no word for a/an. English works differently: one test needs a: I have a test.
feedback.he: בעברית אין מילה ל-a/an. באנגלית לפני מבחן אחד צריך a: I have a test.

explanation.en: I have a test on Sunday morning: a/an before one test, and on for a day + part of the day.
explanation.he: I have a test on Sunday morning: ‏a לפני מבחן אחד, ו-on ליום + חלק מהיום.

prompt.en: Read the email from a language school and answer the questions.
prompt.he: קראו את המייל מבית ספר לשפות וענו על השאלות.

exercises.title: Your first week
exercises.passage:
Hi Kenji,
Welcome to Sunrise Language School! Here is some information about your first week. Your English classes are on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday at 9:30 in the morning. There's a conversation club every Tuesday at 6 in the evening, and it's free! The school is closed at the weekend. In July and August, classes start early, at 8:00, because the afternoons are very hot. Our first trip is on 14 June. See you on Monday!
Sara, Student Office

0.en: The conversation club is in the evening. The classes are 'at 9:30 in the morning'.
0.he: מועדון השיחה בערב. השיעורים 'at 9:30 in the morning'.

1.en: Nothing happens at night. The classes are 'at 9:30 in the morning'.
1.he: שום דבר לא קורה בלילה. השיעורים 'at 9:30 in the morning'.

explanation.en: 'Your English classes are on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday at 9:30 in the morning.'
explanation.he: 'Your English classes are ... at 9:30 in the morning' – השיעורים בבוקר.

questions.statement: The conversation club is on Tuesdays.

explanation.en: 'There's a conversation club every Tuesday' – every Tuesday = on Tuesdays.
explanation.he: 'There's a conversation club every Tuesday' – כל יום שלישי.

questions.statement: Kenji can study at the school on Saturday.

explanation.en: 'The school is closed at the weekend.' Saturday is part of the weekend.
explanation.he: 'The school is closed at the weekend' – בית הספר סגור בסוף השבוע, ושבת היא חלק ממנו.

questions.question: Why do classes start early in July and August?

1.en: The trip is on 14 June, and it isn't the reason. Look for because.
1.he: הטיול ב-14 ביוני, והוא לא הסיבה. חפשו את המילה because.

2.en: The email doesn't say this. Look for because.
2.he: המייל לא אומר את זה. חפשו את המילה because.

explanation.en: '...classes start early, at 8:00, because the afternoons are very hot.'
explanation.he: '...classes start early, at 8:00, because the afternoons are very hot' – כי אחר הצהריים חם מאוד.

answers: on

explanation.he: עם תאריך אומרים on: on 14 June.

prompt.en: Listen and type what you hear.

exercises.audio_text: I usually get up at seven, but at the weekend I sleep late.
answers: I usually get up at seven, but at the weekend I sleep late.
I usually get up at seven, but on the weekend I sleep late.

hint.en: Two times: a clock time and the weekend.

explanation.en: at seven (a clock time) · at the weekend (British English; American: on the weekend).
explanation.he: at seven (שעה) · at the weekend (אנגלית בריטית; באמריקאית on the weekend).

prompt.en: You're making a plan with a friend. Say the sentence out loud.
prompt.he: אתם קובעים עם חבר או חברה. אמרו את המשפט בקול.

exercises.target: See you on Wednesday at three o'clock.

focus.en: Wednesday sounds like WENZ-day (the first d is silent). Start with /w/: round lips, not v. three: tongue between your teeth.
focus.he: Wednesday נשמע כמו 'וֶנְז-דֵיי' – ה-d הראשונה לא נשמעת. מתחילים ב-/w/: שפתיים מעוגלות, לא v. ב-three קצה הלשון בין השיניים.

explanation.en: on + day, at + clock time: on Wednesday at three o'clock.
explanation.he: on + יום, ‏at + שעה: on Wednesday at three o'clock.

task.en: Write 5-6 sentences about your week. When do you work or study, do sport, see friends and relax? Use at, on and in, and at least one time with every or next.
task.he: כתבו 5-6 משפטים על השבוע שלכם: מתי אתם עובדים או לומדים, עושים ספורט, פוגשים חברים ונחים? השתמשו ב-at, ב-on וב-in, ולפחות פעם אחת ב-every או ב-next.

exercises.model_answer: I study at the university on Sundays, Mondays and Wednesdays. My classes usually start at nine in the morning. On Tuesday evening I play basketball with my friends. I work in a café on Thursdays, and I finish at midnight! I relax at the weekend. My exams are in June, so I study every day in May.

checklist.en: at + clock times (at nine, at midnight).
on + days and dates (on Tuesday evening, on 5 May).
checklist.he: on + ימים ותאריכים (on Tuesday evening, on 5 May).

checklist.en: in + months, years, seasons and parts of the day (in June, in the morning).
checklist.he: in + חודשים, שנים, עונות וחלקי היום (in June, in the morning).

checklist.en: No preposition before every or next.
checklist.he: אין מילת יחס לפני every או next.

checklist.en: Days and months start with a capital letter.

explanation.en: The model mixes all three: at nine, on Tuesday evening, in June, and every day with no preposition.
explanation.he: בתשובה לדוגמה יש את שלושתן: at nine, on Tuesday evening, in June – ו-every day בלי מילת יחס.

key_points.en: at + clock times, at night, at midnight · on + days and dates · in + months, years, seasons, parts of the day.
key_points.he: at + שעות, at night, at midnight · ‏on + ימים ותאריכים · ‏in + חודשים, שנים, עונות וחלקי היום.

key_points.en: in the morning, but on Friday morning (a day → on).
key_points.he: in the morning, אבל on Friday morning (כשיש יום → on).

key_points.en: No preposition before every, next, last, this: every Monday, next week.
key_points.he: אין מילת יחס לפני every, next, last, this: every Monday, next week.

key_points.en: the weekend: at (UK) or on (US), never in. Days and months take capital letters.
key_points.he: סוף השבוע: at (בריטית) או on (אמריקאית), אף פעם לא in. ימים וחודשים – באות גדולה.
